abstract: In 90 patients aged 17 to 35 who suffered from Hodgkin's disease (HD) or had testicular tumors (TT), the location of chromosome and chromatid breaks on individual chromosome segments was reviewed using an adapted Funes-Cravioto scheme, in addition to examining the percentage of structural chromosomal aberrations. On the basis of an analysis of 1121 breaks in patients with HD or TT, the results were presented graphically as multiples of the expected number of breaks for the normal population. Before the beginning of treatment, the number of structural chromosomal aberrations (SCA) in patients with TT or HD was equal to that in a control group of subjects with malignant diseases. This, however, does not apply to the location of chromosome and chromatid breaks. In patients with HD, the dominant unstable sites are located on group A2 chromosomes, segments 2 and 5, and on group B chromosomes, segment 5. In patients with TT, the number of chromosome and chromatid breaks is also increased on group A2 chromosomes, segments 2 and 5, and in addition, also on group B chromosomes, segment 4.
abstract_ja: 17歳から35歳までのホジキン病（HD）または精巣腫瘍（TT）の患者90例において、染色体および染色分体切断の部位を、改変したFunes-Cravioto法を用いて検討し、構造的染色体異常の割合も調べた。HDおよびTT患者の合計1121か所の切断を解析し、結果は正常集団で期待される切断数の倍数としてグラフに示した。治療開始前、TTまたはHD患者の構造的染色体異常（SCA）の数は、悪性疾患の対照群と同等であった。しかし、これは染色体および染色分体切断の部位には当てはまらない。HD患者では、優勢な不安定部位はA2群染色体のセグメント2および5、ならびにB群染色体のセグメント5に存在した。TT患者では、A2群染色体のセグメント2および5に加え、B群染色体のセグメント4でも切断数が増加していた。
